title: Testing an API
learning_objectives: Write unittest tests for an API with TestClient
Cover success paths, status codes, validation, authentication and missing resources
Keep tests independent by building a fresh app per test
Judge test quality by whether broken versions of the API are caught
hints: One behaviour per test: 201 on create; 401 without the header; 404 for /notes/99; 422 for an empty title.
Create two notes and check the ids are 1 and 2 — that catches the 'every id is 1' bug.
Check that `GET /notes` returns titles in creation order after creating two notes.

failure_feedback.advice: One of your expectations is wrong for the correct app; re-read the API description.
Assert that creating a note returns status 201.
Send a request without the X-Token header and expect 401.
Request a note id that does not exist and expect 404.
Post an empty title and expect 422.
Create two notes and check their ids differ (1 and 2).
Create two notes and check GET /notes lists them oldest first.
